messages:
jess_sales: Heads-up: Alpha Wealth wants an explicit 'EU-only' promise for a 14-day POC. They said no telemetry or backups outside EU. Need subprocessors list and price delta if we must guarantee it.

tony_presales: Quick take: hosted can be pinned to EU region and we can use EU-only telemetry vendors, but hosted can't give a contractual absolute unless we lock backups and telemetry configs; Dedicated/Private is the safe route.

anya_security: We can supply a subprocessors export and an attestation doc. If they require contractually-binding EU-only processing, legal will want BYOK or key custody terms and audit rights. That's typically a blocker for hosted.

mike_ops: Operationally we can spin a tenant pinned to eu-central and disable cross-region backups during the POC window. Caveat: autoscale burst may route new instances in other regions unless we provision capacity up front. For absolute guarantee, reserve Dedicated capacity.

jess_sales: Alpha asked for a ballpark uplift for Dedicated for 10 seats for 2 weeks. any quick numbers?

mike_ops: Rough: short-term dedicated reservation ~30% uplift over hosted on a short-term window, could be higher depending on GPU types. include a minimum monthly commitment clause.

infra_bot: subprocessors export ready: s3://exports/alpha_wealth/poc_subprocessors_2026-03-21.csv (contains vendors, regions, SCCs).

tony_presales: Suggested scoping snip to send customer: "We will process and store POC data in EU regions. Hosted accounts will have EU affinity; if contractual EU-only processing is required, Dedicated or Private deployment must be purchased and BYOK key custody may be requested."

anya_security: Add: "We will provide a subprocessors list and completed vendor attestations for the POC period." Also flag that telemetry vendors may ingest metadata unless we switch them to EU endpoints.

jess_sales: I'll attach the infra export and send the scoping note. I'll also ask Alpha if they accept a hosted-affinity approach or need a firm contractual clause.

mike_ops: If they go hosted-affinity, include a brief burst policy: reserved headroom or guaranteed capacity to avoid cross-region fallback.

jess_sales: doing that now. ETA EOD. will loop back here after customer reply. :thumbsup:
